candidate_commit_message: CHG-113-r1: add evidence readiness and URL provenance

migration.name: CHG-113 evidence readiness and application URL provenance
migration.evolution: Additive and idempotent. Legacy actionable rows are held at REVIEW until a current score pass writes the evidence and qualification readiness contract.
migration.content_versioning: The migration and strategy-only rescoring do not create employer-content versions. Trusted source-content changes continue through source_snapshot, immutable job_versions, and field diffs.

evidence_readiness_model.source_verification_state: The existing source-verification vocabulary, including verified direct ATS, verified canonical ATS, verified JSON-LD, assisted board, unverified discovery, and identity mismatch.
evidence_readiness_model.actionable_requirement: APPLY_NOW, APPLY_VOLUME, and HIGH_VALUE_STRETCH require evidence_readiness_state=READY and qualification_readiness_state=READY. Qualification readiness includes every current CHG-170 gate.
evidence_readiness_model.missing_evidence_behavior: Missing or partial detail, unresolved requirements/domain, unverified source, and unverified destination remain REVIEW. Missing detail is not treated as a negative domain or requirement fact.
evidence_readiness_model.explanation: evidence_readiness_json stores observed evidence with source/type, role URLs, gate evidence, missing items, blocking items, readiness decision, and current recommendation/reason.

url_provenance_roles.discovery_url: Original search-card/discovery URL; first discovery is retained on the canonical job.
url_provenance_roles.board_detail_url: Observed LinkedIn, Indeed, or Glassdoor detail page.
url_provenance_roles.observed_board_apply_url: Apply action/link observed on a board; observation alone is not employer or ATS verification.
url_provenance_roles.employer_job_url: Employer career/job page from trusted source evidence.
url_provenance_roles.ats_requisition_url: Public ATS requisition URL with a job-specific requisition identity.
url_provenance_roles.verified_application_url: Final employer or public ATS destination whose provenance and job identity are verified. No form submission or credential interaction is performed.
url_provenance_roles.compatibility: Existing canonical_url and apply_url remain available; role/state fields carry the distinct semantics. ATS host parsing requires a valid host boundary and requisition-specific URL.

deterministic_fixture_outcomes.fixture: Card/title-only Trauma Registrar, Cancer Registrar 2, and Weekend Admissions Screener
deterministic_fixture_outcomes.result: Persisted as recall/discovery with detail and requirements missing; final domain/readiness remains REVIEW and never Actionable from title alone.

deterministic_fixture_outcomes.fixture: Higher-education registrar with transcript, student-record, and registration responsibilities; complete CHG-170 gates and trusted ATS destination
deterministic_fixture_outcomes.result: Evidence and qualification readiness READY; Actionable recommendation permitted.

deterministic_fixture_outcomes.fixture: Nonclinical healthcare enrollment/records operations role with matching responsibilities and complete evidence
deterministic_fixture_outcomes.result: Evidence and qualification readiness READY; Actionable recommendation permitted.

deterministic_fixture_outcomes.fixture: Enriched licensed clinical role and unrelated healthcare sales role
deterministic_fixture_outcomes.result: Not Actionable; the clinical case retains its explicit licensure/qualification reason and the sales case retains its evidence-backed responsibility/domain result.

deterministic_fixture_outcomes.fixture: Complete board detail with no trusted employer/ATS destination
deterministic_fixture_outcomes.result: BOARD_ONLY destination state; final readiness REVIEW and verified_application_url empty.

deterministic_fixture_outcomes.fixture: Spoofed ATS hostname and ATS board URL without a requisition identity
deterministic_fixture_outcomes.result: Not recognized as verified ATS requisition provenance.

reconciliation_and_versioning_outcomes.matching_board_to_ats: Matching company/title/requisition evidence reconciles to one canonical job, adds the higher-authority ATS occurrence/provenance, and retains the original board occurrence, discovery URL, board detail URL, and observed apply link.
reconciliation_and_versioning_outcomes.identity_mismatch: Incompatible company/title or ATS requisition evidence fails closed into a separate blocked identity-mismatch record; the prior canonical verification and verified destination are not upgraded.
reconciliation_and_versioning_outcomes.strategy_rescore: Configuration-only rescoring recomputes gates/readiness/scores/recommendation and creates no new employer-content version.
reconciliation_and_versioning_outcomes.trusted_content_change: Changed trusted description/requirements recalculates domain, requirements, CHG-170 gates, readiness, score, and recommendation, and creates the normal immutable content version and diffs.

rtk python3 -m compileall -q src/jobbot tests; rtk git diff --check

request_binding: Project OS BUILD for JobBot CHG-113-r1 on exact integrated main 8d4570537e9577e6c74f43422321afc54c0d0700. Implement the remaining evidence-completeness and application/source-provenance layer without duplicating CHG-170 or CHG-114. Work only on codex/jobbot-CHG-113-r1; never merge or move main.
